authority_statement: Informational report only; the deterministic LFighter pipeline retains all security decision authority.
executive_summary: Observed behavior showed an elevated DDoS-to-Benign prediction rate in the plain attack branch and a lower rate in the defended branch.

facts.statement: The plain attack mean DDoS-to-Benign prediction rate was 0.620162, versus 0.040246 in the paired clean branch.
The defended mean DDoS-to-Benign prediction rate was 0.117223, an absolute reduction of 0.502938 from the plain attack branch.
Mean malicious recall was 0.975000, minimum malicious recall was 0.900000, and maximum benign false-positive rate was 0.000000.
Normalized attribution distance decreased from 0.643485 to 0.476135, with recovery fraction 0.260068.

interpretations.statement: The observed prediction behavior is consistent with targeted suppression of DDoS predictions toward the Benign class, but it does not establish malicious intent.
Reconstruction moved the attribution profile toward its paired preattack clean reference; this is not evidence of oracle clean restoration.

refusals: Refuse to assert verified malicious intent; the supplied evidence does not establish it.
Refuse to claim oracle clean recovery; oracle-clean attribution state was unavailable.
uncertainties: The clean attribution comparator is the paired round 4 preattack reference rather than an oracle clean state.
Rejected and oracle-clean attribution states were unavailable and were not substituted.
Per-client detector scores and numeric threshold values were not present in the selected summary artifacts.
The evidence is development and validation evidence; reserved test arrays remained closed.
